# cursor_organization_group_membership (Resource)

Manages one member of a manually managed Cursor Enterprise Organization Group. Manage SCIM-backed membership in the identity provider instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cursor_team_member" "developer" {
  email = "developer@example.com"
}

data "cursor_organization_group" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering"
}

resource "cursor_organization_group_membership" "engineering_developer" {
  group_id = data.cursor_organization_group.engineering.id
  user_id  = data.cursor_team_member.developer.user_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Organization group ID with the g_ prefix.
- `user_id` (String) Cursor public user ID with the user_ prefix.

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) Email address of the group member.
- `id` (String) Composite group_id/user_id membership ID.
- `name` (String) Display name of the group member.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cursor_organization_group_membership.engineering_developer g_abc123/user_def456
```
